explanation: Keep fewer than k candidate counters, decrementing every counter when k distinct candidates accumulate. Rescan the stream to count the survivors exactly and retain only those above the strict n/k threshold.
timeComplexity: O(n) amortized expected map operations across two passes, plus string hashing
